name: Rapid Strike Urshifu

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is {Water} and {Fighting} type.

attacks.name: Tornado Shot
attacks.text: Discard a {Water} Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack also does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon.

flavor:
This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in
defeating foes by raining many blows down on
them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.
